prompts:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE polished portrait English-learning poster, the first of a coordinated pair, with exceptionally readable accurate English typography. Title "TIME PREPOSITIONS" subtitle "IN • ON • AT". Warm charming high-detail 3D clay and plastic miniature park diorama, soft playful lighting, blurred park background, pastel teal, peach, cream and gold. Structured educational infographic with three broad descending horizontal tiers, generous spacing, very large labels, clean flat readable text plaques integrated with dimensional scenes. No Chinese text, no watermark.
TOP TIER: heading "IN" subtitle "Years • Months • Seasons • Parts of the day". Four miniature bubbles with snowman winter, falling autumn leaves, calendar reading 2024, floral April calendar. Exact phrase labels: "in winter", "in autumn", "in 2024", "in April". Under them a small sunrise / afternoon sun / evening sunset strip labeled "in the morning", "in the afternoon", "in the evening". These are the only IN examples.
MIDDLE TIER: heading "ON" subtitle "Days • Dates • Specific mornings". Charming gift boxes, Monday sign and December calendar with 25 circled, birthday cake with a circled calendar day; one little clay child pointing to Monday. Exact labels "on Monday", "on December 25", "on my birthday". A distinct smaller sunrise-and-Monday-calendar vignette labeled "on Monday morning". Keep this phrase within ON tier.
BOTTOM MAIN TIER: heading "AT" subtitle "Clock times • Noon • Night". Detailed adorable miniature clock tower, clock shows exactly five o'clock, sunset sky. Exact labels "at 5:00 p.m.", "at 7:00 a.m.", "at noon", "at midnight", "at night". Mini sun and moon symbols distinguish times; noon analog clock exactly 12, midnight 12 with moon. Avoid implying analog clock alone encodes a.m./p.m.
FOOTER, visually distinct cream strip, heading "NO PREPOSITION". Four plain unobscured phrase tiles, verbatim: "this morning" / "next Monday" / "last year" / "every day". Do not put in/on/at before these phrases.
Maintain clear learning hierarchy: IN broader periods, ON named days and dates, AT times, with parts-of-day examples accurately assigned. Legibility and grammatical correctness take priority over decorative detail. Render every requested phrase clearly with no duplicated or invented labels.

Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE polished portrait English-learning poster, second of a coordinated pair. Title "MORE TIME PREPOSITIONS". Warm charming high-detail 3D clay/plastic miniature park diorama aesthetic, pastel teal peach cream gold, rounded readable text plaques, soft playful light, blurred miniature park backdrop. Consistent orderly five stacked spacious learning panels, clear English typography, no Chinese, no watermark. Small clay child recurring. Each panel shows a tiny visual scene AND large accurate phrase labels. All examples must be faithfully readable; prioritize text accuracy over clutter.
PANEL 1 heading "BEFORE / AFTER". Two sequential miniature lunch scenes, before lunch the child waits beside an untouched meal, after lunch empty plate. Exact captions "before lunch" and "after lunch". Clear small timeline arrow.
PANEL 2 heading "FROM ... TO ...". Miniature school or work timeline with clock endpoints nine and five. Exact caption "from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m." and tiny subtitle "Start → End". Active period shaded between endpoints.
PANEL 3 heading "BY / UNTIL". Two contrasted simple timelines ending at 5:00 p.m. Left a child finishes a drawing, completion checkmark before or at deadline; exact sentence "Finish by 5:00 p.m." with short explanation "Deadline". Right a child continuously works along filled timeline up to five; exact sentence "Work until 5:00 p.m." and explanation "Continue to this time". Do not conflate deadline and duration.
PANEL 4 heading "FOR / SINCE / DURING". Three clear small vignettes. FOR: bracket across two hours, caption "for two hours", short explanation "How long". SINCE: Monday calendar start with a solid line continuing to NOW, caption "since Monday", explanation "From a starting point". DURING: miniature classroom meeting inside a bounded time band, caption "during the meeting", explanation "When something happens".
PANEL 5 heading "IN / WITHIN". Two miniature clocks/timelines from NOW to two hours later, recurring child returns. Left a single arrival marker exactly at +2 hours, caption "I'll be back in two hours." short explanation "Two hours from now". Right return checkmark anywhere within the shaded interval up to and including +2 hours, caption "I'll be back within two hours." short explanation "No later than two hours from now". Clearly teach the contrast between time from now and a maximum time limit.
All five panels feel part of one charming coherent poster. Retain ample whitespace, strong heading hierarchy, large sentence text, precise arrows/endpoints, flat readable typography, delightful but subordinate 3D scenes.
